text:
Anna: Heads up — product asked for a single-key UX where org owners can create project-scoped API keys with explicit consent. Need API + console design and migration plan.

Mike: Quick context: customers want one key per integration, but restrictable to projects + scopes. Console should return raw key once. Also need exchange flow for short-lived tokens for services.

Sarah: From API side: two options:
- Treat keys as persistent service_account creds tied to an org and optionally pinned to projects
- Make keys lightweight references that must be exchanged for a project-scoped JWT

My proposal: persistent key (owner-only) + POST /v1/auth/exchange to mint project-scoped token with TTL and scopes. Keep DB small, centralized revoke.

Josh: Security: prefer ephemeral tokens. Require create-time consent UI listing projects & scopes. Audit log for who created key + effective scopes. Rotation API + revocation list.

Lisa: DevEx: console should show Last used, Created by, Rotate, CLI copy. CLI example:
```
redwood auth exchange --key-id key_abc123 --project proj-xyz --scopes inference:generate,embeddings:query --ttl 3600
```

Sarah: Example exchange request server-side:
```
POST /v1/auth/exchange
{
  "key_id": "key_abc123",
  "project": "proj-xyz",
  "scopes": ["inference:generate"],
  "ttl_seconds": 3600
}
```
Response: `{ "access_token": "ey...", "expires_in": 3600, "project": "proj-xyz" }`

Anna: Quotas question: attribute usage to `project` claim on exchanged token, fallback to org for legacy keys. Product prefers per-project quotas with inheritance.

Mike: Routing/authz: runtime uses token.project claim. If org-scoped legacy token, use org default routing but mark telemetry. Policy engine: check claims.project || claims.org and enforce route/capacity.

Josh: Impl constraints: tokens must include `kid` header pointing to key id; check revocation + policy store (fast cache). Minimize claims. Add `origin` claim (console/cli/server) for anomaly detection.

Sarah: Policy pseudo:
```
allow if token.claims.project == request.project && token.claims.scopes contains request.scope;
else deny;
```
Add cache invalidation on rotate.

Anna: Migration: keep existing keys valid but tag `org_scoped:true`. When owner visits console show banner + one-click "Create project-scoped key" wizard. Deprecation window 90 days with email/in-console nags.

Lisa: UX copy for consent modal: "This key will allow access to project X and the following actions: generate text, create embeddings. Only org owners can create or rotate this key." :eyes: 

Mike: Next steps: Sarah + Josh estimate API + auth changes (exchange, revocation, claims). Lisa + Anna own console flows. I'll draft rollout comms and quota mapping doc.

Sarah: I'll PR a thin API prototype tomorrow with exchange endpoint & key verify middleware.

Josh: I'll spec revocation list + telemetry events (key.create, key.exchange, key.rotate, key.revoke) and add to audit schema.

Anna: Sounds good — thumbs if aligned. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploy v2/auth-service to staging succeeded for branch feature/auth-exchange

Mike: OK sync in standup if blockers. Thanks all.
